episode.logline: After defying her own despair to cure a fever-stricken village boy with her mother's herbal remedies, Lady Juliana learns that the Dowager Duchess is secretly withering away from a mysterious illness inside Ashbury Manor.
episode.continuity_notes: Directly follows Episode 20's cliffhanger where Catherine and Rupert plotted to seize Ashbury upon the Dowager Duchess's demise; in the village, Juliana puts aside her grief over her burned cottage to save young Toby, stumbling upon critical intelligence regarding the manor.

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Medium shot of Lady Juliana in a rustic grey gown, her wrists wrapped in white bandages, smoothing a blanket over a straw pallet in the dimly lit barn.

events.label: ACTION:
events.text: Lady Juliana gently straightens the grey wool blanket over the hay bed, exhaling a soft, exhausted sigh.

events.label: SOUND FX:
events.text: A loud wooden slam as the heavy double barn doors violently fly open.

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Wide shot framing the open doorway against the overcast daylight as Prudence, a young village girl in an apron, rushes inside, frantic and weeping.

events.label: PRUDENCE (Desperate, Panicked):
events.text: "Lady Juliana! Please! You have to help me, Toby is dying!"

events.label: ACTION:
events.text: Lady Juliana hurries over, placing her bandaged hands reassuringly on Prudence's trembling shoulders.

events.label: LADY JULIANA (Gentle, Urgent):
events.text: "Oh dear. Breathe. Tell me what has happened."

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Medium close-up of Lady Juliana looking into Prudence's tearful face with compassionate urgency.

events.label: PRUDENCE (Sobbing, Breathless):
events.text: "My little brother Toby... his chest is burning! He cannot breathe!"

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up of Prudence weeping, clutching her hands to her chest in agony.

events.label: LADY JULIANA (Inquiring, Strained):
events.text: "Tell me what the apothecary said. Did he not give you medicine?"

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up of Lady Juliana, her brow furrowing with concern.

events.label: PRUDENCE (Anguished, Resentful):
events.text: "He shut the door in my face because we have no silver!"

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up of Prudence, her face twisted in bitter anguish as she gestures back toward the rain-soaked outdoors.

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Wide shot of Lady Juliana and Prudence facing each other inside the wooden barn, dust motes drifting in the pale light.

events.label: PRUDENCE (Bitter, Tearful):
events.text: "The manor doctor laughed! He said village boys are not worth his time!"

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Medium profile shot of Lady Juliana looking down at her bandaged hands, holding Prudence's hand with somber heartache.

events.label: LADY JULIANA (Sorrowful, Dejected):
events.text: "We have no clinic now."

events.label: LADY JULIANA (Despondent):
events.text: "Our cottage is ashes. I have nothing left but this coltsfoot."

events.label: ACTION:
events.text: Prudence drops desperately to her knees onto the hay-strewn barn floor, clasping her hands in tearful supplication.

events.label: PRUDENCE (Pleading, Desperate):
events.text: "He is only seven! If you do not come, he will die! You are his only hope, Lady Juliana!"

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: High-angle looking down at Prudence kneeling before Lady Juliana, pleading upward.

events.label: ACTION:
events.text: Lady Juliana immediately reaches down and pulls Prudence firmly back to her feet, then turns to snatch her heavy leather-bound herbal ledger from the wooden workbench.

events.label: LADY JULIANA (Resolute, Authoritative):
events.text: "Stand up. Sinking to your knees will not save him. Let me grab my ledger. We go now."

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Medium shot framing the barn entrance as Lady Juliana lifts Prudence up, grabs her book, and leads the way out.

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Tracking wide shot following Lady Juliana and Prudence running side by side along a muddy, puddled village road past thatched stone cottages under a gloomy, overcast sky.

events.label: ACTION:
events.text: Lady Juliana clutches the thick book to her chest as she and Prudence sprint swiftly through the village.

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Low-angle medium shot of seven-year-old Toby lying on a makeshift straw pallet before a roaring fireplace, coughing weakly.

events.label: SOUND FX:
events.text: Heavy, raspy chest coughs echoing in the small room, accompanied by crackling hearth fire.

events.label: ACTION:
events.text: Lady Juliana rushes in, sets the ledger on the rustic wooden table, and quickly flips open the pages.

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up of Lady Juliana rapidly scanning the botanical illustrations and handwritten remedies in the book.

events.label: LADY JULIANA (Alarmed, Focused):
events.text: "His skin is burning hot."

events.label: ACTION:
events.text: Lady Juliana places her bandaged hand against Toby's flushed, sweating forehead as he wheezes painfully.

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Medium close-up of Lady Juliana tending to Toby, with Prudence standing anxiously in the background.

events.label: LADY JULIANA (Commanding):
events.text: "Prudence, fetch hot water immediately!"

events.label: PRUDENCE (Hurried, Obedient):
events.text: "Yes! Right away, I will get it!"

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Medium shot of Prudence nodding rapidly, rushing toward the stone hearth.

events.label: ACTION:
events.text: Prudence wraps a cloth around the iron handle of the steaming kettle resting over the hearth fire and lifts it.

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up top-down view of Lady Juliana's bandaged fingers gently touching an ink illustration of chamomile flowers in the open ledger.

events.label: LADY JULIANA (V.O.) (Introspective, Determined):
events.text: "I cannot let my own weariness stop me. This boy needs my mother's knowledge."

events.label: ACTION:
events.text: Lady Juliana crushes dried herbal leaves into a dark wooden bowl between her bandaged hands, then pours steaming water over them from the kettle.

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up of hot water pouring into the bowl, releasing aromatic vapors from the dried herbs.

events.label: ACTION:
events.text: Lady Juliana sits beside the pallet and brings the steaming herbal bowl close to Toby's face while Prudence cradles his shoulders.

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Medium shot of Lady Juliana, Prudence, and Toby huddled together by the warm glow of the fire.

events.label: LADY JULIANA (Instructive, Calm):
events.text: "Lift his shoulders, Prudence. Hold the steam close. Let him inhale."

events.label: PRUDENCE (Tearful, Coaxing):
events.text: "Like this? Toby, breathe it in, sweet boy."

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up of Prudence supporting Toby's head, whispering tenderly into his ear.

events.label: LADY JULIANA (Encouraging, Reassuring):
events.text: "Yes, just like that. Keep breathing, Toby. Let the vapor clear your chest."

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up of Lady Juliana gently waving her hand to direct the medicinal steam toward Toby's nose and mouth.

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up of Toby's face relaxing, his chest falling still and calm.

events.label: ACTION:
events.text: Toby's strained wheezing eases into quiet, rhythmic breathing as he slips into peaceful sleep on his pillow.

events.label: PRUDENCE (Overwhelmed, Relieved):
events.text: "Oh, thank God! His chest is quiet! The rattling has stopped!"

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up of Prudence covering her mouth in overwhelmed relief, tears streaming down her face.

events.label: ACTION:
events.text: Lady Juliana pulls the plaid wool blanket snug over Toby's chest, smiling softly with profound relief.

events.label: LADY JULIANA (Gentle, Caring):
events.text: "Keep him warm. Give him three drops of this coltsfoot tea every morning."

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Medium shot of Lady Juliana sitting on a stool beside Toby's bedside, placing a cup of coltsfoot tea on a small wooden table.

events.label: PRUDENCE (Grateful, Choked with Emotion):
events.text: "You saved him. The grand doctors left him to choke, but you..."

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Medium close-up of Prudence looking at Lady Juliana with awe and boundless gratitude, her hands clasped in front of her.

events.label: PRUDENCE (Fervent, Devoted):
events.text: "I have no money, Lady Juliana, but I swear on my life, I will do anything to repay you."

events.label: ACTION:
events.text: Lady Juliana takes Prudence's trembling hands into hers, smiling with heartfelt warmth.

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up of Lady Juliana comforting Prudence warmly.

events.label: LADY JULIANA (Warm, Sincere):
events.text: "Your brother's breath is payment enough for me, Prudence."

events.label: PRUDENCE (Indignant, Resentful):
events.text: "At the grand manor, they ignore us. They only care about their own luxury."

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Low-angle shot past sleeping Toby toward Prudence standing in the room, her expression darkening with anger.

events.label: PRUDENCE (Ominous):
events.text: "But their gold cannot buy them health."

events.label: ACTION:
events.text: Lady Juliana turns sharply, her eyes widening with sudden recognition.

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up of Lady Juliana looking directly into Prudence's eyes with startled concern.

events.label: LADY JULIANA (Startled, Curious):
events.text: "What do you mean? Is someone ill? The Dowager Duchess?"

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Low-angle cut to Toby sleeping peacefully as the fire crackles behind him.

events.label: PRUDENCE (Solemn, O.S.):
events.text: "She is dying, Lady Juliana."

events.label: PRUDENCE (Conspiratorial, Grim):
events.text: "A strange, mysterious illness is eating her away."

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up of Prudence leaning in close to Lady Juliana, whispering with grave intensity.

events.label: PRUDENCE (Dark, Chilling):
events.text: "Inside that massive house with all their wealth, she is fading to nothing, and no one can stop it."

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Brief cut back to Toby sleeping peacefully on his straw pillow by the warm fireplace.

events.label: ACTION:
events.text: Lady Juliana sits motionless at the rustic wooden table, her bandaged hands holding open her late mother's leather-bound herbal ledger. Her eyes reflect deep apprehension as the dire truth settles over her.

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Slow push-in on Lady Juliana staring down at the ancient pages, her expression filled with profound realization and growing resolve as dramatic strings swell to a gripping cliffhanger.
